verdict.rationale: PayPal ships an official Agent Toolkit SDK in TypeScript and Python. It covers orders, invoices, subscriptions, tracking, disputes and refunds, with integrations for OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, Bedrock and MCP. It is published from the official paypal/agent-toolkit GitHub repo and confirmed live on npm (@paypal/agent-toolkit 1.11.0, latest). The REST portal also lists Server SDKs. Missing for 10: hands-on confirmation of the Python package, and SDK coverage of the Store Sync cart/agentic-commerce surface (which is a merchant-hosted reverse API rather than an SDK).
